name: AnimalTreatmentWithdrawalLog
tagline: Veterinary medicine records with meat and milk withdrawal countdowns – know which animals are clear before they leave the farm.
description: A complete livestock medicine book for Power Apps and Power Pages: record treatments for single animals or whole groups with batch, expiry, dose and route as prescribed, see every animal's meat and milk clear date on a withdrawal board, check an ear tag before sale or slaughter, release animals only after the clear date (and a negative milk test), and track medicine batches and stock. A record-keeping aid – not veterinary advice.
features: Meat and milk clear dates per treatment and per animal (overlapping treatments)
Cascade (off-label) minimum withdrawal and safety margin
Expired batch blocking and batch stock with low / expiring / expired alerts
Release workflow with optional negative milk test
Bulk complete, release and cancel with skip lists
CSV export, withdrawal list and reorder list to Power Fx
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (two controls: AnimalTreatmentWithdrawalLog data-set + AnimalTreatmentWithdrawalLogPortal field control, shared src/app)
